evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion without addressing an audience or invoking authority.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Controls the framing of what counts as valuable — supplying the interpretive fact itself (informational) while arguing from a logical distinction (rational-persuasion).
